g.text: POST /api/ai-agents/{id}/save/prepare + /send — append a new version to an agent
Phase 1 — prepare (deploys nothing; new version minted here)
A save appends: earlier versions stay readable
and deployable. The payload is a full
replacement, not a diff. Teams reference agents
by pinned (id, version), so saving never moves
a team off the version it validated.
